map.输精管造影通畅度评估工具，逐段评估输精管/精囊/射精管通畅情况，辅助梗阻性无精子: A vasography patency-assessment tool that evaluates the vas deferens/seminal vesicle/ejaculatory duct segment by segment, aiding diagnosis of obstructive azoospermia.
map.请根据输精管造影影像学所见，逐段选择通畅情况: Select patency segment by segment per the vasography imaging findings
map.评估分段：输精管→精囊腺→壶腹部→射精管→造影剂入尿道/膀胱: Segments assessed: vas deferens → seminal vesicle → ampulla → ejaculatory duct → contrast entering urethra/bladder
map.通畅度分级：通畅（造影剂顺利通过）/ 部分梗阻（造影剂通过缓慢或狭窄）/ 完全梗: Patency grading: patent (contrast passes smoothly) / partial obstruction (contrast passes slowly or narrows) / complete obstruction (contrast cannot pass)
map.本工具供影像学评估参考，需结合精液分析和临床综合判断: This tool is for imaging-assessment reference and should be combined with semen analysis and clinical judgment.
map.评分 0=梗阻、1=部分、2=通畅；双侧全部 2 → 双侧通畅，不支持梗阻性无精: Score 0=obstruction, 1=partial, 2=patent; both sides all 2 → bilateral patent, not supporting obstructive azoospermia.
map.左某段评 0 → 左侧梗阻；若仅单侧且对侧通畅，仍有自然受孕可能，可先观察。: A left segment scored 0 → left-side obstruction; if only unilateral with the contralateral patent, natural conception is still possible, observe first.
map.逐段（腹股沟/盆段/壶腹等）评 0–2，任一段 0 即该侧梗阻，双侧 0 为梗阻: Score each segment (inguinal/pelvic/ampulla, etc.) 0–2; any segment 0 means that side is obstructed, bilateral 0 means obstructive azoospermia.
map.双侧梗阻常选 PESA+ICSI；单侧可据精液参数决定是否手术探查。: Bilateral obstruction often chooses PESA+ICSI; unilateral may decide on surgery based on semen parameters.
